messages:
rachel: Quick decision thread: narrow private-deploy defaults so RFC isn't blocked. Need: default network mode, upgrade default, telemetry policy, and one-liner comms.

bryce: Default = operator + relay. Minimal friction. Offer NAT (static egress) as second mode. BGP = opt-in enterprise with SE.

imani: Upgrades default to rolling canary (configurable: percent + window). Abort & rollback on failed smoke checks. Blue/green documented for advanced customers only.

ash: Telemetry default OFF for private. Provide `redwoodctl telemetry consent --scopes=errors,perf` that emits signed audit token. Installer should expose `--preflight-only --output=json`.

rachel: Draft comms blurb: "Default installer uses relay to avoid routing work. If you need preserved egress IPs choose NAT or contact SE for BGP onboarding. Expect rolling upgrades; plan for 15-60m typical window."

ops-bot: Ticket PD-9999 created: "private-deploy defaults RFC" assigned to @rachel @bryce @imani @ash.

rachel: Action items: Bryce -> preflight checklist, Imani -> rollout & rollback thresholds, Ash -> telemetry CLI spec. RFC goal EOD Thu.

bryce: ack

imani: ack

ash: ack
thread_text_summary: Concise alignment: relay default, NAT for egress, BGP enterprise opt-in; rolling canary upgrades with auto-rollback; telemetry default off; action owners assigned
